# chameleon_principal (Data Source)

Look up an existing Polaris principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_principal" "etl" {
  name = "etl-pipeline"
}

output "etl_client_id" {
  value = data.chameleon_principal.etl.client_id
}
```
